Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding the use of electronic wireless communications devices for text messaging while operating a moving motor vehicle.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to operating a motor vehicle while reading,writing, or sending electronic messages; adding a new section tochapter 46.61 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as provided in subsection (2) of this section, a personoperating a moving motor vehicle while reading, manually writing, orsending a text message on an electronic wireless communications deviceis guilty of a traffic infraction. (2) Subsection (1) of this section does not apply to a personoperating: (a) An authorized emergency vehicle; (b) A moving motor vehicle who is also operating an amateur radioand who holds a current, valid amateur radio station license issued bythe federal communications commission; or (c) A moving motor vehicle while using an electronic wirelesscommunications device to: (i) Report illegal activity; p. 1 EHB 1214 (ii) Summon medical or other emergency help; or (iii) Prevent injury to a person or property.
